note: Additive critical-mineral and industrial-mineral site batch. Each site has a unique country-scoped identifier, coordinates, map eligibility, reserve, rate, capacity, extraction method, raw warehouse, transport route, compatible factory binding, processing outputs and source lineage. Project/deposit/quarry records preserve non-operating or uncertain real-world status separately from OMEGA's simulated playable state. Two additional coral-aggregate resource areas are documented for Majuro, Marshall Islands and Funafuti Lagoon, Tuvalu; their source-status flags explicitly do not assert current operating mine permits. The duplicate Estonia Ojamaa identifier was replaced with the USGS-documented Piceance Basin oil-shale resource area in Colorado; its real-world status explicitly does not claim a currently operating mine.
sourcePolicy: Public operator, government, regulator or academic sources support site/project/commodity context. All quantitative production, grade, recovery, purity, capacity and 400-year reserves are deterministic gameplay-only simulation values and are never represented as measured real-world facts. Coral-aggregate resource-area records are sourced from regional studies/government project documents; current permits and operator status are not asserted, and all production/reserve values remain simulation-only. Resource-area profiles based on USGS geological assessments do not imply an operating or licensed mine; all generated quantities remain simulation-only.
